reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Frontier AI, superintelligence and misalignment
themes.definition: Concern about frontier or agentic AI that may surpass human intelligence, is not understood by its creators, and poses risks of misuse, misadventure or misalignment with human objectives.
themes.inclusion: Include passages on superintelligence, loss of understanding or control, misalignment, or frontier AI risks.
themes.exclusion: Exclude military autonomous weapons (AI_MILITARY_WEAPONS) and ordinary criminal misuse (AI_CYBER_SECURITY).
themes.boundary_cases: A company race toward superintelligence is coded here when the risk is the capability itself, and also AI_SOVEREIGNTY_CONCENTRATION if corporate power is stressed.

examples.quote: The principal risks of frontier AI will therefore come from misuse, misadventure or misalignment with human objectives.
the stated aim of those companies is to build superintelligence, AI that strives
to surpass intelligence in every possible way. Some people working on that think it is just a few years away.

themes.label: New multilateralism and AI safety summits
themes.definition: Calls for international cooperation, a new form of multilateralism and summits to build shared understanding of AI risks and make AI safe.
themes.inclusion: Include calls for international action, shared risk understanding, or summit processes on AI safety or governance.
themes.exclusion: Exclude endorsements of specific UN bodies only (AI_UN_ROLE).
themes.boundary_cases: Statements on the importance of democratic rule-based cultures for safe AI may be coded here or AI_DEMOCRATIC_VALUES.

examples.quote: that challenge requires a new form of multilateralism — because it is only by working together that we will make AI safe for everyone

themes.label: Company races and power of few
themes.definition: Concern that AI is driven by a competitive race among companies and countries, that tech firms hold country-sized influence, and that decisions should not be left to a few.
themes.inclusion: Include passages on corporate or state competition over AI, the outsized influence of tech companies, or decisions being concentrated in few hands.
themes.exclusion: Exclude access-gap framings about developing countries (AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE).
themes.boundary_cases: Applause for voluntary company safety commitments alongside race concerns is coded here.

examples.quote: the starting gun has been fired on a globally competitive race in which individual companies, as well as countries, will strive to push the boundaries as far and fast as possible
ensure that decisions about artificial intelligence are not left in the hands of a few

themes.label: Democratizing tool that can be misused
themes.definition: AI framed as a democratizing, empowering tool for all that can equally be used for ill, requiring both benefit-sharing and risk preparation.
themes.inclusion: Include explicit pairing of AI's empowering potential with its dangers.
themes.boundary_cases: Calls to both prepare for risks and distribute benefits fairly count here and may also be AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE.

examples.quote: AI can and should be a tool for all. Yet any technology that can be used by all can also be used for ill.
we must not only prepare for the risks of those technologies but also distribute their benefits more fairly

themes.label: Criminal, terrorist and state misuse of AI
themes.definition: Examples of AI already being misused by hackers, terrorists, cybercriminals with deepfakes, and repressive states.
themes.inclusion: Include concrete examples of AI misuse for crime, terrorism, election manipulation, or repression.
themes.boundary_cases: Deepfakes used to dupe voters also qualify for AI_DISINFORMATION.

examples.quote: teens hacking individuals’ bank details, terrorists targeting Government systems, cybercriminals duping voters with deepfakes and bots, even States suppressing their peoples

themes.label: Autonomous weapons already in use
themes.definition: Observation that autonomous weapons without human control are already used in current wars.
themes.inclusion: Include references to autonomous weapons or AI in warfare.
themes.boundary_cases: AI agents transacting with humans are not military and belong to AI_TRANSFORMATIVE_SIGNIFICANCE.

examples.quote: autonomous weapons systems without human fingers on the triggers are already with us — witness the wars around us

themes.label: AI as defining test of era
themes.definition: AI presented as an epochal transformation or defining leadership test with profound implications for societies, politics and economies, including AI agents indistinguishable from humans.
themes.inclusion: Include rhetorical framings of AI as the greatest test, a revolution, or a profound societal shift without specifying a policy domain.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages whose main point is a specific risk or governance proposal.
themes.boundary_cases: A one-sentence statement of AI's importance with no further content is coded here rather than AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION because AI is singled out.

examples.quote: In the years ahead, there may well be no greater test of our leadership than how we deal with AI.
AI agents with the ability to negotiate and transact with each other and humans, and often we will not be able to tell the difference

themes.label: Support for SG AI Advisory Body
themes.definition: Support for the recommendations of the Secretary-General's High-level Advisory Body on AI.
themes.inclusion: Include endorsements of UN AI bodies or their recommendations.
themes.exclusion: Exclude national or G7 summit processes.
themes.boundary_cases: If paired with 'not in the hands of a few', also code AI_SOVEREIGNTY_CONCENTRATION.

examples.quote: We must support those recommendations and move forward with that common effort

themes.label: Democratic openness as basis for safe AI
themes.definition: Argument that liberal democracies with open expression, rules and transparency are best placed to build AI capacity and make AI safe.
themes.inclusion: Include passages linking democratic values, openness, or transparency to AI innovation and safety.
themes.boundary_cases: Mentions of states using AI to suppress people are coded AI_CYBER_SECURITY unless contrasted with democratic AI.

examples.quote: A culture of rules and transparency is essential to creativity and innovation, and it is just as essential to making AI safe.

value.rationale: The samples, dominated by the UK 2023 speech, focus on frontier AI safety: superintelligence races, misalignment, and a new multilateralism via summits. Minority strands include concrete misuse, autonomous weapons (Singapore), AI's epochal significance (USA), and support for the UN advisory body against concentration (Spain).
